slug: 2024-11-05 Togo - Integrating DHIS2 with existing EMIS systems

facts.fact: The Ministry of Primary, Secondary, Technical Education, with Norad, GPE KIX and HISP WCA support, is piloting DHIS2 alongside the existing StatEduc application, which continues as the data-collection tool; the page gives national scale since 2019.

systems.owner: Ministry of Primary, Secondary, Technical Education
Ministry of Primary, Secondary, Technical Education

TGO.note: The document covers education information only and states nothing about health reporting.
